products.title: Project Intelligence Mapper
products.objective: Understand an existing repository before changing it
steps: inventory routes, entry points, schema and services
products.inputs: Repository tree, package files, migrations, documentation; read-only initially
products.verification: Golden fixture repos; correct IDs; evidence citations; no source edits by default

products.title: Complete Product Architect
products.objective: Turn vague ideas into complete, verifiable product specifications
products.inputs: Idea, country/business fields, stakeholder constraints and existing repo when provided
products.outputs: PRD.md; feature-register.xlsx/csv; sitemap.md; permissions.csv; architecture-decision-records.md; implementation-plan.md
products.verification: No invented critical decisions; explicit assumptions; conditional legal checks; compare output against complete reference briefs

products.title: Product Completeness Auditor
products.objective: Identify forgotten parts of existing applications
steps: enumerate onboarding, account lifecycle, admin, payments and offboarding
products.inputs: Repository, documented product model and optionally authorized app preview
products.verification: Route presence != functional flow; avoid claiming legal certification; measure false positives with deliberately incomplete apps

products.title: UX & Accessibility Inspector
steps: screen reader and manual review recommendations
products.inputs: Accessible app/browser code and permitted preview
products.verification: Automated scans do not certify compliance; clear manual-test-required flags

products.title: Security & Authorization Auditor
products.inputs: Authorized repository and stated threat model
products.verification: No intrusive testing of third parties; avoid invented vulnerabilities; reports require source evidence

products.title: Database Integrity Guardian
products.inputs: Read-only schema and test fixture data; DBA approval for production
products.verification: Read-only default; no production data mutation without explicit authorization and recovery plan

products.title: Regression & Testing Guardian
products.objective: Protect existing behavior across code changes
products.inputs: Current diff, tests, repo context and requested requirements
products.verification: Baseline must be observed; distinguish not-run, failed and passing; execute actual tests

products.title: Payments & Subscription Engineer
products.objective: Implement and validate robust payment lifecycles
products.inputs: Payment sandbox provider credentials and application repo
products.verification: Sandbox only by default; mock/payment evidence; no real payments without authorization

products.title: Legal & Compliance Readiness
products.objective: Identify applicable obligations for digital products
steps: Determine legal operator, geography, B2B/B2C, tracking, data mapping and suppliers
list required disclosures and consumer flow
products.inputs: Jurisdiction, product model, data flows, supplier list
products.verification: Educational readiness assessment not legal advice; no blanket compliance certification

products.title: Root Cause Investigator
products.inputs: Authorized repo, sanitized logs, reproducible symptom, environment constraints
products.verification: Do not change production before permission; do not conclude without evidence

products.title: Production Readiness Commander
steps: Build/CI/test state, secrets/config, DB migration plan, object access, payment provider, DNS/TLS, email, legal, backup/restore, logs, capacity, fallback/rollback, support readiness
products.inputs: Repository, deployment manifests, available staging checks and release data
products.verification: Must block when evidence missing; no claim of production readiness from code inspection alone

products.title: Multi-Agent Engineering Orchestrator
steps: Task dependency mapping, agent specialization, context budget, ownership boundaries, tool permissions, parallel execution, integration, independent review and tests, cost/time logging
products.inputs: Goal, repository, agent capabilities and authorization limits
products.verification: No conflicting simultaneous file writes; separate agent claims from executed validation

products.title: The Incomplete Product Brief
steps: Author full PRD, acceptance tests and traceability

products.title: Build a Complete SaaS
steps: Applicable legal/info pages as reviewed examples

products.title: Launch a Digital Business
steps: Legal applicability matrix and page placements
